messages:
Implement JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) resolution

Add resolvePointer(document, pointer), exported from src/index.ts, with
tests covering the RFC's own example vectors plus the syntax and
resolution error cases (invalid escapes, missing members, out-of-bounds
and malformed array indices, indexing into non-containers). Add
TypeScript and @types/node as dev dependencies and a typecheck script
to enforce the existing strict tsconfig.
